sourceTitle: Classic Fruit Salad with Honey and Lemon
sourceText:
Classic Fruit Salad with Honey and Lemon
By: Foodie Foodster
Published: Wednesday, March 4, 2015 - 3:06pm

Ingredients




1 cup cubed pineapple
1 cup chopped strawberries
1/2 Mango, cubed
1/2 cup blueberries
1 banana, sliced
1 tsp honey
1 squeeze of lemon
1 tsp Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla Bean Paste (see end)

Preparation

1 Throw all of the fruit in a bowl. 2 Drizzle honey, squeeze lemon, and add vanilla bean paste. 3 Fold gently and let sit in refrigerator for at least 10 minutes.
